accounting.web_policy_relation: alias consistency check for web_search only

activation_gate: owner adoption review explicitly accepts v3 artifacts
separate integration change owned by runner/provider owners
intended-runtime acceptance if integration later changes major runtime

lifecycle.name: validate
lifecycle.rule: accept only the closed common logical request; reject unsupported operation or any extra field before reservation

lifecycle.name: reserve
lifecycle.rule: atomically increment the fixed per-cell operation counter before any native invocation

lifecycle.name: translate
lifecycle.rule: emit one typed exact native contract and a hash-bound reservation receipt; perform no live invocation

lifecycle.name: external_invocation_boundary
lifecycle.rule: not implemented or authorized by this candidate; future integration may invoke only after a valid reservation

lifecycle.name: settle
lifecycle.rule: consume reservation exactly once as PASS, FAIL, or UNKNOWN; malformed settlement consumes UNKNOWN

lifecycle.name: fence
lifecycle.rule: UNKNOWN, redirect/final-origin uncertainty, timeout, oversize, or window expiry has zero retry, replay, or provider status query

url_admission.query: allowed as part of exact requested URL
